summary: The seven accepted held-out TS-domain structures were submitted for frozen MatRIS/AQCat25 exact-structure prediction on MZ73 and compatible SIGMA=0.20 eV VASP static energy-force labels on sunboquan-codex.

payload.objective: Collect the accepted seven-structure held-out frozen-model predictions and compatible VASP static labels, then compare MatRIS/AQCat25 errors without training leakage.
current_evidence: MZ73 Slurm job 1326 binds seven exact structures to frozen MatRIS and AQCat25 checkpoint hashes; no training is enabled.
LSF jobs 9731537 through 9731543 bind the same seven structures to NSW=0, ISMEAR=1, SIGMA=0.20 eV VASP static labels.
All seven diagnostic-static execution gates explicitly allowed SUBMIT_DIAGNOSTIC_VASP before submission.
held_boundary_12 remains diagnostic-only and is excluded from the six-structure primary aggregate.
No fine-tuning, checkpoint promotion, path rerun, micro-NEB, Dimer, frequency, TS acceptance, or barrier action is authorized.
payload.one_executable_step: Wait for GPU job 1326 and VASP jobs 9731537-9731543 to finish, collect and quality-check exact-structure outputs, then compare frozen MatRIS-VASP and AQCat25-VASP errors on the six disjoint primary structures with held_boundary_12 reported separately.
payload.submission_boundary: Only the recorded frozen predictions and VASP diagnostic static labels are submitted; all model-training and TS-production actions remain unauthorized.
done_when: All eight jobs finish with complete quality-passed outputs.
Held-out force and relative-energy errors are reported for both frozen models on the six primary structures.
The diagnostic failure-boundary structure is reported separately and no calibrated-uncertainty or accepted-TS claim exceeds the evidence.
